name: Fire
description: Casts Fire-elemental attack magic against a single enemy or all enemies.
location: Buy: Sector 7 Slums, Sector 5 Slums, Wall Market, Fort Condor, Mideel, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1); initially equipped on Red XIII

name: Ice
description: Casts Ice-elemental attack magic against a single enemy or all enemies.
location: Buy: Sector 7 Slums, Sector 5 Slums, Wall Market, Fort Condor, Mideel, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1); initially equipped on Cloud

name: Lightning
description: Casts Lightning-elemental attack magic against a single enemy or all enemies.
location: Buy: Sector 7 Slums, Sector 5 Slums, Wall Market, Fort Condor, Mideel, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1)

name: Earth
description: Casts Earth-elemental attack magic that hits all grounded enemies.
location: Buy: Kalm, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1)

name: Restore
description: Restores HP and, at higher levels, grants Regen over time.
location: Buy: Sector 7 Slums, Sector 5 Slums, Wall Market, Fort Condor, Mideel, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1); Find: No. 1 Reactor

name: Heal
description: Cures status ailments and eventually grants resistance to them.
location: Buy: Kalm, Junon, Costa del Sol (Part 1), Gongaga

name: Revive
description: Revives a KO'd ally and restores part of their HP.
location: Buy: Junon, Costa del Sol (Part 1)

name: Seal
description: Inflicts Sleep and, later, Silence on enemies.
location: Buy: Junon, Costa del Sol (Part 1)

name: Mystify
description: Inflicts Confusion and, later, Berserk on enemies.
location: Buy: Gongaga, Cosmo Canyon

name: Transform
description: Shrinks or turns enemies into frogs, weakening them.
location: Buy: North Corel, Cosmo Canyon, Gongaga, Mideel (after Ultimate Weapon); Find: Corel Bridge; initially equipped on Cait Sith

name: Exit
description: Allows fleeing from battle and, later, removing enemies from combat.
location: Buy: Rocket Town

name: Poison
description: Casts Poison-elemental damage and inflicts the Poison status.
location: Buy: Kalm, Costa del Sol, Junon (Part 1); Find: Shinra Bldg. Floor 67

name: Gravity
description: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's current HP.
location: Buy: Costa del Sol (Part 2/3), Mideel (after Ultimate Weapon); Find: Cave of the Gi

name: Barrier
description: Casts defensive barriers against physical and magic damage, later adding Reflect and Wall.
location: Buy: Rocket Town

name: Comet
description: Summons falling comets that strike random enemies.
location: Find: Forgotten City

name: Time
description: Alters the flow of time, hastening allies or slowing and stopping enemies.
location: Buy: Gongaga, Rocket Town

name: Destruct
description: Strips buffs from enemies and can instantly kill non-immune foes.
location: Buy: Fort Condor (Part 2/3), Mideel (after Ultimate Weapon); Find: Shinra Mansion (Part 1)

name: Contain
description: Casts powerful elemental and non-elemental attack magic, culminating in Flare.
location: Find: Mideel; give the White Chocobo a Mimett Greens, then scratch its ear

name: Full Cure
description: Fully restores a single ally's HP in one cast.
location: Find: Cosmo Canyon (Part 2/3)

name: Shield
description: Grants an ally complete immunity to physical attacks.
location: Find: Northern Cave

name: Ultima
description: Casts the powerful non-elemental spell Ultima on all enemies.
location: Find: North Corel, reward for stopping the runaway coal train (or a special 50,000 gil purchase if it crashes)

name: Master Magic
description: Grants every Magic spell in the game at once; already mastered.
location: Cosmo Canyon: bring a mastered copy of every Magic Materia to the green Huge Materia; also given by the Kalm traveler for the Earth Harp

name: Slash-All
description: Attacks all enemies with a single sword strike.
location: Find: Ancient Forest

name: Double Cut
description: Allows consecutive physical attacks in a single turn.
location: Find: Sunken Gelnika, Research Room

name: W-Magic
description: Casts two Magic spells in a single turn.
location: Find: Northern Cave

name: W-Summon
description: Casts two Summons in a single turn.
location: Battle Square prize for 64,000 BP (after obtaining the Highwind)

name: W-Item
description: Uses two items in a single turn.
location: Winding Tunnel, during Mako Cannon Rampage (or dig it up at Bone Village if missed)

name: Steal
description: Attempts to steal an item from an enemy; later combines stealing with an attack.
location: Buy: Kalm; Find: Sewers beneath Wall Market

name: Sense
description: Reveals an enemy's HP, MP, and weaknesses.
location: Buy: Junon (Part 1), Kalm; Find: Sector 6 playground; initially equipped on Red XIII

name: Throw
description: Throws items or weapons at enemies; later allows throwing gil for damage.
location: Buy: Fort Condor, Rocket Town (after Highwind); initially equipped on Yuffie

name: Morph
description: Turns a sufficiently weakened enemy into an item.
location: Find: Temple of the Ancients, boulder room

name: Deathblow
description: A high-risk physical attack with a greatly increased critical hit chance.
location: Buy: Fort Condor, Rocket Town (after Highwind); Find: Gongaga forest

name: Manipulate
description: Takes control of an enemy, forcing it to use its own abilities for the party.
location: Buy: Fort Condor, Rocket Town (after Highwind); initially equipped on Cait Sith

name: Mime
description: Repeats the last command used by any party member at no MP or item cost.
location: Find: Materia Cave, Wutai Area

name: Enemy Skill
description: Learns powerful Blue Magic spells by being hit with them by certain enemies.
location: Find: Shinra Bldg. (missable), Junon Beginner's Hall, Forgotten Capital, Chocobo Sage's home (four separate copies)

name: Master Command
description: Grants Steal, Sense, Throw, Morph, Deathblow, Manipulate, and Mime at once; already mastered.
location: Cosmo Canyon: bring mastered Steal, Sense, Throw, Morph, Deathblow, Manipulate and Mime to the yellow Huge Materia; also given by the Kalm traveler

name: Choco/Mog
description: Summons Choco/Mog to attack all enemies and inflict Stop.
location: Chocobo Farm; interact with a Chocobo by the fence

name: Shiva
description: Summons Shiva to deal Ice-elemental damage to all enemies.
location: Under Junon, gift from Priscilla

name: Ifrit
description: Summons Ifrit to deal Fire-elemental damage to all enemies.
location: Cargo Ship, after defeating Jenova-BIRTH

name: Ramuh
description: Summons Ramuh to deal Lightning-elemental damage to all enemies.
location: Chocobo racing lounge at Gold Saucer

name: Titan
description: Summons Titan to deal Earth-elemental damage to all enemies.
location: Gongaga reactor (hidden, obtainable before North Crater on Disc 2)

name: Odin
description: Summons Odin, who has a chance to instantly kill all enemies with Zantetsuken.
location: Nibelheim, second floor safe in Shinra Mansion (code: Right 36, Left 10, Right 59, Right 97)

name: Leviathan
description: Summons Leviathan to deal Water damage to all enemies.
location: Defeat Godo in Wutai

name: Bahamut
description: Summons Bahamut to unleash Mega Flare on all enemies.
location: Temple of the Ancients, after defeating the Red Dragon

name: Kujata
description: Summons Kujata, striking enemies with combined Fire, Ice, and Lightning damage.
location: Found in Sleeping Forest

name: Alexander
description: Summons Alexander to deal Holy-elemental damage to all enemies.
location: Great Glacier, after visiting the Hot Springs and speaking to the Snow Woman

name: Phoenix
description: Summons Phoenix, dealing Fire damage to enemies while reviving fallen allies.
location: Fort Condor, after the Huge Materia mission (or excavated at Bone Village)

name: Neo Bahamut
description: Summons Neo Bahamut for a stronger non-elemental attack on all enemies.
location: Found in Whirlwind Maze

name: Hades
description: Summons Hades to inflict a wide array of status ailments on all enemies.
location: Sunken Gelnika storage room

name: Typhon
description: Summons Typhon to deal heavy damage and lower enemy stats.
location: Found in Ancient Forest treetops

name: Bahamut ZERO
description: Summons Bahamut ZERO for a devastating non-elemental Tera Flare attack.
location: Cosmo Canyon, blue Huge Materia (requires both Bahamut and Neo Bahamut, or excavate at Bone Village)

name: Knights of the Round
description: Summons the thirteen Knights of the Round for the single strongest attack in the game.
location: Materia Cave on Round Island; requires a Gold Chocobo

name: Master Summon
description: Grants unlimited use of every Summon in the game; already mastered.
location: Cosmo Canyon, red Huge Materia (requires all 16 mastered Summon Materia); also given for the Earth Harp after defeating Emerald Weapon

name: Added Cut
description: Follows up the linked Materia's use with an automatic physical attack on the same target.
location: Great Glacier

name: Added Effect
description: Chance to inflict the linked Materia's status on hit when on a weapon, or grants immunity to it when on armor.
location: Cave of the Gi (missable)

name: All
description: Lets a linked Magic or Summon Materia target all allies or enemies at once.
location: Sector 7 Slums, Shinra Bldg. (FL63), Cargo Ship, Mt. Nibel, Great Glacier, Fort Condor shop (after Highwind), Snowboarding Course B prize

name: Counter
description: Grants a chance to counter physical attacks using the linked command Materia.
location: Northern Cave

name: Elemental
description: Gives equipment the element of the linked Materia; on armor it resists, then nullifies, then absorbs that element.
location: Shinra Bldg. (FL62, guess the mayor's password), Mt. Nibel mako fountain, or play Tifa's piano in Nibelheim with Tifa as leader

name: Final Attack
description: Automatically triggers the linked Materia's effect the moment the wearer is KO'd.
location: Battle Square special battle prize (missable)

name: HP Absorb
description: Restores HP to the user equal to 10% of the damage dealt by the linked Materia.
location: Wutai, Northern Cave

name: Magic Counter
description: Grants a chance to counter attacks by casting the linked Magic or Summon Materia.
location: Northern Cave, Chocobo Square race prize

name: MP Absorb
description: Restores MP to the user equal to 1% of the damage dealt by the linked Materia.
location: Wutai item shop (missable)

name: MP Turbo
description: Increases the linked Magic or Summon's damage and MP cost by a percentage.
location: Whirlwind Maze (missable)

name: Quadra Magic
description: Casts the linked Magic or Summon Materia four times in a row for a single MP cost.
location: Materia Cave near Mideel Area

name: Sneak Attack
description: Grants a chance for the wearer to automatically use the linked Materia when battle begins.
location: Chocobo Square race prize

name: Steal as well
description: Attempts to steal an item whenever the linked command Materia is used.
location: Da-chao Statue in Wutai

name: Cover
description: Grants a chance to intercept attacks aimed at a weaker ally.
location: Sector 5 Slum, near Aerith's house

name: Chocobo Lure
description: Increases the chance of a random encounter with a Chocobo on the world map.
location: Buy: Chocobo Farm (from Choco Billy); also found near the farm's fence after obtaining the Highwind

name: Long Range
description: Lets physical attacks hit at full damage regardless of the character's row.
location: Mythril Mine

name: Counter Attack
description: Grants a chance to counter physical attacks with a physical attack of its own.
location: Defeat Materia Keeper in Mt. Nibel; also a chocobo racing prize

name: Enemy Lure
description: Increases the random encounter rate.
location: Battle Square prize

name: Speed Plus
description: Increases the wearer's Dexterity by a percentage.
location: Battle Square prize

name: MP Plus
description: Increases the wearer's maximum MP by a percentage.
location: Buy: Cosmo Canyon, Mideel

name: HP Plus
description: Increases the wearer's maximum HP by a percentage.
location: Junon (score 60-90 during Rufus's send-off); Buy: Cosmo Canyon, Mideel

name: Luck Plus
description: Increases the wearer's Luck by a percentage.
location: Temple of the Ancients (missable)

name: Magic Plus
description: Increases the wearer's Magic stat by a percentage.
location: Corel Valley

name: Gil Plus
description: Doubles the amount of gil earned in battle.
location: Wonder Square prize (after obtaining the Highwind)

name: Pre-Emptive
description: Increases the chance of a pre-emptive strike at the start of battle.
location: Battle Square prize; also equipped on Cloud during the Nibelheim flashback

name: EXP Plus
description: Increases the Experience earned by the wearer in battle.
location: Wonder Square prize (after Cloud and Tifa rejoin the party)

name: Enemy Away
description: Decreases the random encounter rate.
location: Chocobo racing prize

name: Mega All
description: Lets physical attacks and certain commands hit all enemies or allies at once.
location: Northern Cave

name: HP<->MP
description: Swaps the wearer's current HP and MP values.
location: Materia Cave north of Corel

name: Underwater
description: Removes the time limit when fighting Emerald Weapon underwater.
location: Kalm traveler (missable if the Morph Materia was missed)
